facts.business: Aptus Pharma Limited is engaged in the marketing and distribution of branded generic pharmaceutical formulations across acute and chronic therapeutic segments, with expanding consumer healthcare and international business verticals, using an asset-light contract manufacturing model.
key_risks: Pricing pressure from competition, trade margins, tenders and DPCO/NPPA price controls
Regulatory non-compliance, manufacturing or quality failures, product recalls, supply delays or licence loss at company or contract manufacturers
Dependence on third-party manufacturers and concentration in material products, distributors, customers or regions
Volatility in input, packaging, freight and foreign-exchange costs; counterfeit products; IP disputes; changes in market or prescribing practices
